stale.name: Description
stale.text: The mark shares the video's calm movement toward useful text. In a title reveal, the voiced body can settle from a slightly fuller low shape into its final rising contour while the caret remains fixed. Keep the change short and local; the final silhouette should hold long enough to become familiar. A faintly perceptible expansion of the voice body could relate to the existing 3.4-second breathing cadence, but the caret should not wobble, pulse or perform an attention-seeking blink. For a transition into the application, use a cut or restrained crossfade to real editable text; do not imply that all recognition instantly becomes a completed rewrite. The licensed water footage stays behind the film composition, never inside the transparent logo. Reduced motion uses the fully formed static pair. This is a study relationship, not a proposal to change the production recorder's status behavior.

stale.name: Description
stale.text: The mark shares the video's calm movement toward useful text. In a title reveal, the voiced body can settle from a slightly fuller low shape into its final rising contour while the caret remains fixed. Keep the change short and local; the final silhouette should hold long enough to become familiar. A faintly perceptible expansion of the voice body could relate to the existing 3.4-second breathing cadence, but the caret should not wobble, pulse or perform an attention-seeking blink. For a transition into the application, use a cut or restrained crossfade to real editable text; do not imply that all recognition instantly becomes a completed rewrite. The licensed water footage stays behind the film composition, never inside the transparent logo. Reduced motion uses the fully formed static pair. This is a study relationship, not a proposal to change the production recorder's status behavior.
